description: Reserve all required Work Order materials from the configured raw material warehouse and make the Work Order ready for production

body.message: Materials reserved successfully. Work Order is now READY_TO_PRODUCE.

400.description: Invalid Work Order state or insufficient stock

examples.message: Insufficient stock for one or more Work Order materials
Work Order must be PLANNED or MATERIAL_SHORTAGE to reserve materials

403.description: User does not have the PLANNER role

businessRules: The endpoint has no request body; resolve the source warehouse using the configured code RAW_MATERIAL_WAREHOUSE
Consider only AVAILABLE stock balances within the resolved source warehouse
Select eligible lots in FIFO order by stock_lots.created_at
Allow reservation only from PLANNED or MATERIAL_SHORTAGE
Move to READY_TO_PRODUCE only when all material requirements are satisfied
Machine assignment and availability are validated when production starts, not during reservation
Use pessimistic locking for the Work Order and eligible stock balances
Reserve all materials atomically; do not create partial reservations
Create one immutable RESERVE movement per selected lot linked to the Work Order
Write RESERVE_MATERIAL audit data for every important status transition
On shortage, set MATERIAL_SHORTAGE, preserve stock/material quantities, and return structured shortage details
